title.narrative: Supporting Colombia in implementing its climate, energy and biodiversity goals

description.narrative: Colombia has ambitious NDC to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 51% by 2030. The country is currently developing a roadmap for a just energy transition and updating its national biodiversity action plan in accordance with the new global framework (GBF). Financing, political coherence, and monitoring are significant challenges. The project supports Colombia in achieving its climate, energy, and biodiversity goals. It strengthens mechanisms for climate protection and promotes a just energy transition while supporting low-carbon and climate-resilient measures in the industry and mining sectors. Additionally, it enhances the conditions for implementing Colombia's biodiversity goals in line with the GBF. The project fosters political dialogue between Colombia and Germany on climate change, a just energy transition, and biodiversity, as well as promotes knowledge exchange and networking among IKI projects.
